offering_description.value: Underwrites commercial and specialty property and casualty insurance for businesses and personal auto and homeowners insurance for individuals. It distributes policies through independent insurance agents and brokers and handles claims under those policies.

primary_products.value: commercial property and liability packages; specialty liability insurance; workers’ compensation insurance; auto insurance; homeowners insurance

customer_segment.value: B2B: Small and midsize businesses, professional firms, and organizations with specialized risks; B2C: Individuals and families buying auto, home, and related coverage

end_markets.value: small and midsize businesses across industries; construction; manufacturing; professional services; personal auto and homeowners insurance

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: Premiums for commercial, specialty, and personal property and casualty policies

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: Pools premiums from businesses and households and assumes their insured risks

geography_served.value: US national: United States, with coverage availability varying by state and insurance line

specialization.value: related lines: Core commercial, specialty, and personal property and casualty insurance

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: Independent retail insurance agencies and specialty brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State insurance departments oversee insurer licensing, solvency, rates, and policy forms
